Title: Official Source-Route Exhaustion Parking
Purpose: Permit parking of a cohort when a bounded official-source route search has been explicitly closed by an authoritative prior stage and required deterministic source fields remain unavailable.
reopen_conditions: manager-authorized genuinely new official source architecture
official source materially changes and now exposes required deterministic identity/classification fields
manager supplies a captured authoritative official artifact that closes the missing Gate-B requirements
forbidden_route_arounds: per-security fanout merely to bypass the failed bulk-source contract
